## Hypothesis

We are trying to refine the SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK strategy's parameters to better capture J's edge on the 6 anchor days. However, the top keeper from stage2 only captures $373.48 of the possible $1,542 edge, which is below the 50% floor of $771 required for leaderboard eligibility. ## Mechanism

Entry triggers on a level break with volume multiplier >=1.1, minimum body size of 0.02 cents, at least 2 stars, strike offset of 2 (OTM-2 put), and requiring a break above the open. Exit uses a 6% premium stop, 40% TP1 (selling 2/3 of position), 300% runner target, immediate profit lock arming (0% threshold) with an 8% trailing stop offset, and a fixed quantity of 10 contracts.
